animals.meaning: n. 狗;[美俚]丑女人;卑鄙的人;(俚)朋友 vt. 跟踪;尾 随
animals.hint: It is a loyal friend. It wags its tail when it is happy. It loves to play fetch.
animals.idiom: lucky dog 走运的人;underdog 弱势方;let sleeping dogs lie 别惹事

animals.meaning: n. 猫;猫科动物
animals.hint: It has soft paws. It likes to nap in warm places.
animals.idiom: curiosity killed the cat 别多管闲事;copycat 模仿者;*raining cats and dogs* 倾盆大雨

animals.meaning: n. 小狗,幼犬
animals.hint: It is a baby dog. It has tiny paws.
animals.idiom: puppy love 少男少女初恋;puppy dog eyes 可怜巴巴的眼神

animals.meaning: n. 小猫,猫咪
animals.hint: It is a cute word for a small cat.
animals.idiom: 亲昵称呼小猫;金融俚语 *kitty* = 凑份子的小金库

animals.meaning: n. 仓鼠;仓鼠毛皮
animals.hint: It has puffy cheeks that store food. It runs in a wheel at night.
animals.idiom: hamster wheel 原地空转的忙碌(职场隐喻)

animals.meaning: n. 兔子,野兔 vt. 让...⻅⻤去吧
animals.hint: It has long ears. It hops fast. It loves carrots.
animals.idiom: rabbit hole 越陷越深的岔路;pull a rabbit out of a hat 出奇招

animals.meaning: n. 兔子(特别是小兔子);可爱女郎
animals.hint: It is a soft word for a baby rabbit. It hops. It loves carrots in cartoons.
animals.idiom: 复活节 Easter Bunny 美国童书文化;dumb bunny 傻乎乎(略贬)

animals.meaning: n. 金丝雀;金丝雀色
animals.hint: It is a small yellow bird. People keep it in a cage at home. It can sing beautiful songs.
animals.idiom: canary in a coal mine 最早的预警信号

animals.meaning: n. 吉娃娃(一种产于墨⻄哥的狗);奇瓦瓦(墨⻄哥北部 的州及其首府名称)
animals.hint: It is a tiny dog—it fits in a purse. It has big eyes. It comes from Mexico.
animals.idiom: —(品种名为主;*ankle biter* 旧俚指小狗)

animals.meaning: n. 拉布拉多(加拿大东部一地区);一种纽芬兰猎犬
animals.hint: It is a friendly big dog. It loves water. It is often yellow, black, or chocolate brown.
animals.idiom: —(常作导盲犬、家庭犬的美国形象)

animals.meaning: n. 牛头犬,恶犬;短枪管大型手枪
animals.hint: It has a wrinkly face and a wide chest. It looks tough but it can be sweet.
animals.idiom: bulldog spirit 顽强斗志;大学 mascots 常见

animals.meaning: n. 一种活泼的小狗;地籍册;国防自卫队
animals.hint: It is a small lively dog. It loves to dig and chase.
animals.idiom: —(*terrier-like* 形容咬住不放)

animals.meaning: n. 狮子狗 vt. 剪毛
animals.hint: It has curly fancy fur. Sometimes it has a silly haircut. It is a very smart dog.
animals.idiom: poodle 有时喻指唯命是从的随从(政治俚语,成人向)

animals.meaning: n. 小鸡;鸡肉;胆小⻤,懦夫 adj. 鸡肉的;幼小的;胆怯 的
animals.hint: It is a farm bird. We eat its eggs. It has a red comb /kɑːm/ on its head.
animals.idiom: chicken out 临阵退缩;don't count your chickens 别过早乐观

animals.meaning: n. 母鸡;雌禽
animals.hint: It is the mom chicken. It is the lady bird that lays eggs.
animals.idiom: mother hen 过度操心、护犊的家长

animals.meaning: n. 公鸡;狂妄自负的人
animals.hint: It is the dad chicken. It has a big comb /kɑːm/ on its head. It often stands tall on the farm fence.
animals.idiom: cock of the walk 自以为是的老大;*strut like a rooster* 趾高气扬

animals.meaning: n. 奶牛,母牛;母兽 vt. 威胁,恐吓
animals.hint: It has black and white spots. It gives us milk. It eats grass all day.
animals.idiom: have a cow 大发雷霆(美俚);sacred cow 不可批评的禁忌

animals.meaning: n. 鸭子;鸭肉;(英)宝⻉儿;[版]零分 vi. 闪避;没入水 中
animals.hint: It has webbed /webd/ feet. Yellow babies follow mom in a line.
animals.idiom: sitting duck 活靶子;like water off a duck's back 毫不在意;*ugly duckling* 丑小鸭变天鹅

animals.meaning: n. ⻢;骑兵;脚架;[俚]海洛因 vt. 使骑⻢;系⻢于;[口] 捉弄
animals.hint: You can ride it. It runs fast. It is a cowboy’s /ˈkaʊbɔɪz/ best friend.
animals.idiom: hold your horses 别急;dark horse 黑马;horse around 瞎闹

animals.meaning: n. 山羊;替罪羊(美俚);色⻤(美俚)
animals.hint: It has a beard on its chin. It climbs rocks. It eats leaves and grass.
animals.idiom: scapegoat 替罪羊;get someone's goat 惹毛某人

animals.meaning: n. 猪;猪肉;贪吃的人;难伺候的事(习语) vi. 贪婪地吃
animals.hint: It is a pink farm animal. It says oink /ɔɪŋk/. It has a curly tail and a flat nose. It loves mud.
animals.idiom: when pigs fly 绝不可能;pig out 大吃大喝;Peppa Pig 文化符号

animals.meaning: n. 羊,绵羊;胆小⻤
animals.hint: It looks like a fluffy cloud on legs. It gives us wool /wʊl/ for sweaters.
animals.idiom: black sheep 家族害群之马;count sheep 数羊助眠

animals.meaning: n. 公牛;看好股市者;粗壮如牛的人;[俚]胡说八道;印玺 adj. 公牛似的;雄性的;大型的
animals.hint: It is the dad cow. It has strong horns /hɔːrnz/. A red cape /keɪp/ shows up in cartoons(bullfight).
animals.idiom: bull in a china shop 笨手笨脚;take the bull by the horns 迎难而上;*bull market* 牛市

animals.meaning: n. 水牛;野牛(产于北美);水陆两用坦克
animals.hint: It is a big shaggy ox. Or it is the American bison /ˈbaɪsn/ with a huge head.
animals.idiom: buffaloed 旧俚:被唬住、搞懵

animals.meaning: n. 野猪;(未阉的)公猪
animals.hint: It is a wild pig with tusks /tʌsks/. It is strong and hairy.
animals.idiom: —(*boar* 文学里偶喻粗野)

animals.meaning: n. 骡子;固执的人;走私毒品者 n. 拖鞋
animals.hint: Its mom is a horse and its dad is a donkey. It is strong and stubborn /ˈstʌbərn/.
animals.idiom: stubborn as a mule 倔得像骡子

animals.meaning: n. 驴子;傻瓜;顽固的人
animals.hint: It has long ears. It is stubborn /ˈstʌbərn/ but helpful. Eeyore is one in Winnie-the-Pooh.
animals.idiom: stubborn as a mule/donkey;Eeyore 忧郁驴(迪士尼文化)

animals.meaning: n. 羔羊,小羊;羔羊肉 vt. 生小羊,产羔羊
animals.hint: It is a baby sheep. It is soft and white. It stays close to its mom.
animals.idiom: gentle as a lamb;like a lamb to the slaughter 任人宰割

animals.meaning: n. 火鸡;失败之作;笨蛋
animals.hint: It is a big bird for Thanksgiving /ˌθæŋksˈɡɪvɪŋ/. It has a fan tail and a silly walk.
animals.idiom: Thanksgiving 国宴象征;talk turkey 谈正经事;cold turkey 戒断式突然停用

animals.meaning: n. 鹅;雌鹅;鹅肉;傻瓜 vt. 突然加大油⻔;嘘骂
animals.hint: It has a long neck. It curves toward the sky to sing. White feathers float on green water. Red feet paddle /ˈpædl/ the waves. (See 《咏鹅》 in notes.)
animals.idiom: silly goose 傻乎乎(亲昵,常对孩子说);wild goose chase 白费力气;*cook someone's goose* 毁了对方计划

animals.meaning: n. ⻦;家伙;羽毛球 vt. 向...喝倒彩;起哄
animals.hint: It has feathers and wings. Most birds can fly. It lays eggs in a nest.
animals.idiom: early bird gets the worm 早起的鸟儿有虫吃;free as a bird 自由自在

animals.meaning: n. [动]猫头鹰;枭;惯于晚上活动的人
animals.hint: It has big eyes. It turns its head all around. It is active at night.
animals.idiom: wise as an owl;night owl 夜猫子

animals.meaning: n. 鸽子;鸽派人士 v. 潜水(dive的过去式)
animals.hint: It is a white peaceful bird. It is a symbol /ˈsɪmbl/ of love.
animals.idiom: 和平象征(*dove of peace*);鸽派 vs 鹰派政治隐喻

animals.meaning: n. 企鹅;[美俚]空军地勤人员
animals.hint: It lives in Antarctica /ænˈtɑːrktɪkə/. Its body is round and plump. It has short legs and stands up straight. It is black and white. It cannot fly. It waddles /ˈwɑːdlz/ on ice.
animals.idiom: —(*penguin suit* 俚语指男士礼服)

animals.meaning: n. 鹦鹉;学舌者,应声虫;机械模仿别人的人 vt. 机械地模 仿
animals.hint: It is a colorful bird that can copy your words. You can say, "I am a clever/stupid parrot."
animals.idiom: parrot 动词:鹦鹉学舌、人云亦云

animals.meaning: n. 鸽子
animals.hint: It is a gray city bird. It bobbles its head when it walks. It eats crumbs.
animals.idiom: stool pigeon 眼线、告密者(犯罪俚语)

animals.meaning: n. 鹰;鹰状标饰
animals.hint: It has huge sharp eyes. It is the national bird of the USA. It flies very high.
animals.idiom: bald eagle 美国国鸟;eagle eye 目光锐利

animals.meaning: n. 天鹅;天鹅星座 vi. 游荡,闲荡
animals.hint: It is an elegant white bird. It has a long neck and a curved beak /biːk/. You see it in a ballet /ˈbæleɪ/ story.
animals.idiom: swan song 绝唱、谢幕之作;*black swan* 黑天鹅(突发巨变)

animals.meaning: n. 火烈鸟
animals.hint: It is a tall pink bird. It has long thin legs. It stands on one leg in shallow water. Its beak is bent.
animals.idiom: 美式草坪 plastic pink flamingo 装饰;*flamingo pose* 单腿站立(瑜伽/拍照梗)

animals.meaning: n. 海鸥
animals.hint: It lives by the sea. It flies over beaches and looks for food.
animals.idiom: —(海边度假意象;*seagull manager* 管理俚语:瞎插手)

animals.meaning: n. 燕子;吞咽;一次吞咽的量 v. 忍受;吞下;咽下;轻 信;不流露感情;收回
animals.hint: Think BIRD: it is small and fast in the sky. (Also a verb: food goes down your throat /θroʊt/.)
animals.idiom: 动词 *swallow* 吞下;*one swallow doesn't make a summer* 一例不足为凭

animals.meaning: n. 乌鸦;啼叫;欢叫 v. 报晓;啼叫;欢叫;夸口;洋洋自 得
animals.hint: It is a black bird. It is very smart. Sometimes it steals shiny things.
animals.idiom: eat crow 公开认错;as the crow flies 直线距离

animals.meaning: n. 知更⻦
animals.hint: It has a red breast. It is a cute songbird /ˈsɔŋbɜːrd/. You often see it on Christmas cards.
animals.idiom: 圣诞贺卡常客;*robin redbreast* 英式文学意象

animals.meaning: n. ⻦;松鸡;喋喋不休的人
animals.hint: It is a blue noisy bird. It hides acorns /ˈeɪkɔːrnz/ for winter.
animals.idiom: jaywalking 乱穿马路(源自 *jay* 俚语:乡巴佬)

animals.meaning: n. 孔雀;爱虚荣的人;雄孔雀 vi. 炫耀;神气活现地走
animals.hint: It is the boy bird with a huge colorful tail. It opens like a fan.
animals.idiom: proud as a peacock 骄傲得开屏

animals.meaning: n. 麻雀;矮小的人
animals.hint: It is a little brown city bird. It pecks crumbs on the sidewalk /ˈsaɪdwɔːk/.
animals.idiom: —(*sparrow* 圣经/民谣里喻卑微)

animals.meaning: n. [⻦]紫崖燕
animals.hint: It is a small fast bird in the swallow family. It is dark blue and white.
animals.idiom: 暂无常见的亲子友好表达

animals.meaning: n. 蜜蜂,蜂;勤劳的人
animals.hint: It is yellow and black. It makes honey. It flies from flower to flower.
animals.idiom: busy as a bee 忙得团团转

animals.meaning: n. 蚂蚁
animals.hint: It is super strong for its size. It lives in a hill with thousands of friends.
animals.idiom: ants in your pants 坐立不安(儿歌常见)

animals.zh: 蝴蝶 蝶式游泳 游手好闲的人
animals.meaning: n. 蝴蝶 蝶式游泳 游手好闲的人, 轻浮的人
animals.hint: It has colorful wings. It used to be a caterpillar /ˈkætərpɪlər/. It flutters by flowers.
animals.idiom: social butterfly 社交达人;*butterflies in your stomach* 紧张心慌

animals.meaning: n. 瓢虫
animals.hint: It is a UK word for a little red bug with black spots. Americans say ladybug /ˈleɪdibʌɡ/.
animals.idiom: —(美式常说 *ladybug*,*ladybug, ladybug, fly away home* 童谣)

animals.meaning: n. 蜘蛛;设圈套者;三脚架
animals.hint: It has eight legs. It makes webs. It is not an insect /ˈɪnsekt/.
animals.idiom: *spider sense*(蜘蛛侠文化);*Charlotte's Web* 美国童书经典

animals.meaning: n. 蝎子
animals.hint: It has eight legs like a spider. Its tail curls up with a stinger /ˈstɪŋər/. It lives in hot dry places. Stay back—tell a grown-up.
animals.idiom: —(星座 Scorpio /ˈskɔːrpioʊ/;沙漠/动物园常见)

animals.meaning: n. 毛虫 履带
animals.hint: It is a baby butterfly. It has many legs. It eats leaves, then makes a cocoon /kəˈkuːn/.
animals.idiom: 蜕变隐喻(*caterpillar to butterfly*)

animals.meaning: n. 蛾;蛀虫
animals.hint: It is like a butterfly but it comes out at night. It flies toward lights.
animals.idiom: like a moth to a flame 飞蛾扑火

animals.meaning: n. ⻩蜂;胡蜂;易怒的人 vi. ⻩蜂似的直扑
animals.hint: It has a thin waist. It is yellow and black. Be careful—it can sting /stɪŋ/.
animals.idiom: —(*WASP* = White Anglo-Saxon Protestant,社会学术语)

animals.meaning: n. 虫,蠕虫;蜗杆;螺纹;小人物 vt. 给除虫;使缓慢前 进;使蠕动
animals.hint: It is a long pink squiggle underground. Birds love to eat them.
animals.idiom: worm your way in 钻营;*bookworm* 书虫

animals.meaning: n. 甲虫
animals.hint: It has a hard shell on its back. It has six legs. A ladybug is one kind.
animals.idiom: —(*Beatles* 披头士谐音梗)

animals.meaning: n. 大⻩蜂
animals.hint: It is a big angry wasp. Do not poke its nest.
animals.idiom: stir up a hornet's nest 捅了马蜂窝

animals.meaning: n. 蜻蜓
animals.hint: It has big eyes and two pairs of wings. It hovers /ˈhʌvərz/ over ponds.
animals.idiom: 暂无常见的亲子友好表达

animals.meaning: n. 蟋蟀;板球,板球运动
animals.hint: It chirps /tʃɜːrps/ at night—or it is the sport with bats in England.
animals.idiom: —(*crickets* 表尴尬沉默;英式 *cricket* 为板球)

animals.meaning: n. 蚱蜢;蝗虫;轻型⻜机;蚱蜢鸡尾酒
animals.hint: It has big back legs—boing boing! It is a green jumper in grass.
animals.idiom: 功夫片 *Grasshopper* 徒弟称呼(流行文化)

animals.meaning: n. [动]蝉
animals.hint: It is a summer tree insect. It sheds a shell on the bark /bɑːrk/.
animals.idiom: —(美国南方夏天标志性声音)

animals.meaning: n. 蚊子
animals.hint: It is a tiny bug with a long mouth. Its bite is itchy /ˈɪtʃi/.
animals.idiom: —(*mosquito bite* 喻小却烦人的麻烦)

animals.meaning: n. 蜈蚣
animals.hint: It has so many legs! It looks like a train with legs—creepy crawlies.
animals.idiom: 暂无常见的亲子友好表达

animals.meaning: n. ⻘蛙;饰扣;辙叉 vi. 捕蛙
animals.hint: It goes hop hop! It has wet skin. It starts life as a tadpole /ˈtædpoʊl/.
animals.idiom: frog in your throat 嗓子哑/卡痰

animals.meaning: n. 蛇;阴险的人 vi. 迂回前进
animals.hint: It has no legs. It slithers. It has a forked /fɔːrkt/ tongue. Some are dangerous.
animals.idiom: snake in the grass 阴险小人

animals.meaning: n. 海龟;龟,甲⻥
animals.hint: It has a hard shell home. It is slow. In the sea or a pond, it hides its head inside.
animals.idiom: —(*turtle* 股市俚语:慢涨)

animals.meaning: n. 蜥蜴;类蜥蜴爬行动物
animals.hint: It has dry scaly /ˈskeɪli/ skin. It has four legs. It might lose its tail and grow a new one.
animals.idiom: 暂无常见的亲子友好表达

animals.meaning: n. 蟾蜍;癞蛤蟆;讨厌的家伙
animals.hint: It is like a frog but it has bumpier skin. It goes hop hop on land.
animals.idiom: toady 马屁精(源自 toad)

animals.meaning: n. 迟缓的人;龟,乌龟(等于testudo)
animals.hint: It is a land turtle. It is very slow. It wins races in fables /ˈfeɪblz/.
animals.idiom: *slow and steady wins the race* 龟兔赛跑美国启蒙寓言

animals.meaning: n. [动]鬣蜥蜴
animals.hint: It is a big green lizard. It has a spiky back. It sunbathes /ˈsʌnbeɪðz/ on rocks.
animals.idiom: 暂无常见的亲子友好表达

animals.meaning: n. 鳄⻥
animals.hint: It has a long mouth and many teeth. It lives in rivers. It smiles—do not get close!
animals.idiom: crocodile tears 鳄鱼眼泪、假慈悲

animals.meaning: n. 短吻鳄
animals.hint: It is like a crocodile but it has a wider U-shaped snout /snaʊt/. It lives in USA swamps /swɑːmps/.
animals.idiom: See you later, alligator! 五十年代流行儿歌告别语

animals.meaning: n. 大蟒;巨蟒;丹舌
animals.hint: It is a huge snake. It is not venomous /ˈvenəməs/. It squeezes its food.
animals.idiom: —(编程语言 Python 借名,非动物隐喻)

animals.meaning: n. 海豚
animals.hint: It is a smart sea mammal /ˈmæml/. It jumps high. It lives in groups.
animals.idiom: —(*Flipper* 六十年代电视明星海豚)

animals.meaning: n. 螃蟹;蟹肉;脾气乖戾的人;起重机 vt. 抱怨;破坏;使 偏航
animals.hint: It walks sideways. It has pinchy claws /klɔːz/. It turns red when cooked.
animals.idiom: crabby 脾气坏;*crab mentality* 螃蟹心态(扯后腿)

animals.meaning: n. 鲸 vi. 捕鲸 v. 打击
animals.hint: It is the biggest animal ever. It lives in the ocean. It spouts /spaʊts/ water from its head.
animals.idiom: a whale of a time 玩得超开心

animals.meaning: n. 密封;封条;印章;海豹;标志 vt. 密封;盖章
animals.hint: Animal: it is blubbery /ˈblʌbəri/. It claps a ball at the zoo. Or: it closes a door tight.
animals.idiom: —(与 *seal*「盖章」同形异义)

animals.meaning: n. 小⻰虾
animals.hint: It looks like a tiny lobster. It lives in fresh water. It has pinchy claws.
animals.idiom: 美国南方 crawfish boil 社交聚餐文化

animals.meaning: n. [⻥]河豚;⻩麻鲈
animals.hint: It is a puffy fish. It can blow up like a balloon /bəˈluːn/ when scared.
animals.idiom: 暂无常见的亲子友好表达

animals.meaning: n. 小丑鱼(与海葵共生)
animals.hint: It has orange-and-white stripes. Think Nemo! It hides in sea anemones /əˈneməniz/.
animals.idiom: Finding Nemo 美国动画文化符号

animals.meaning: n. 蚌, 蛤 vi. (在沙滩上)挖蛤
animals.hint: It lives in sand. Two shells clamp /klæmp/ tight. Pearls /pɜːrlz/ are inside sometimes.
animals.idiom: happy as a clam 开心极了;*clam up* 闭嘴不言

animals.meaning: n. 扇⻉,干⻉ vt. 使成扇形
animals.hint: It is shellfish with a fan-shaped shell. It is yummy and pretty.
animals.idiom: 暂无常见的亲子友好表达

animals.meaning: n. [动]金枪⻥,鲔⻥
animals.hint: It is a huge fast fish. Pink meat comes in cans. It swims in big schools.
animals.idiom: —(*tuna melt* 美式三明治;*tuna* 邮件俚语:大块正文)

animals.meaning: n. 牡蛎,蚝(oyster的复数形式)
animals.hint: They have rock shells in the sea. Pearls are sometimes inside. They are slurpy /ˈslɜːrpi/ food.
animals.idiom: the world is your oyster 前途无量

animals.meaning: n. 虾;小虾;矮小的人 vi. 捕虾
animals.hint: It is curved pink seafood. It has tiny arms. You can eat popcorn shrimp.
